slides.alt: A person in a mustard sweater reaching over a laid lunch table. Text: Every summer we travel back to our families.
Close-up of fried Hungarian Kolbász sausage slices on a plate. Text: This summer we brought delicious Hungarian Kolbász and grapes from the garden.
